card.title: Name My Contribution
card.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.
